title: Trustworthy Predictive Distributions for Tail Events with Semiparametric Diagnostic Transport Maps
abstract: arXiv:2603.11229v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine learning forecast systems are moving beyond point predictions to full predictive distributions for future outcomes y conditional on complex inputs x. However, these distributions are often locally miscalibrated, especially for high-stakes tail events where accurate uncertainty quantification is most needed to establish trust in models. Local miscalibration occurs because training data often lack examples of low-frequency events. The goal of this paper is to describe a simple, yet flexible framework that, at deployment, produces interpretable diagnostics and a robust correction mechanism of predictive distributions when train examples are limited. translated_title: 基于半参数诊断传输映射的尾部事件可信预测分布
translated_abstract: 机器学习预测系统正从点预测转向针对复杂输入 x 条件下未来结果 y 的完整预测分布。然而，这些分布往往存在局部校准偏差，尤其是在高风险的尾部事件中——此时最需要准确的不确定性量化来建立对模型的信任。局部校准偏差产生的原因在于训练数据通常缺乏低频事件的样本。本文的目标是描述一个简单而灵活的框架，在部署阶段、当训练样本有限时，能够产生可解释的诊断信息以及稳健的预测分布校正机制。围绕这一目标，我们引入了局部摊销诊断与重塑（LADaR）框架的半参数版本，该框架为诊断传输映射设定了一个依赖协变量的参数模型，并在输入上进行非参数回归，以描述如何校正尾部……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出半参数化的LADaR框架，通过在输入上进行非参数回归的协变量依赖诊断传输映射，在训练样本有限时为尾部事件提供可解释的诊断和稳健的预测分布校正。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a semiparametric version of the LADaR framework, which uses covariate-dependent diagnostic transport maps regressed nonparametrically on inputs to provide interpretable diagnostics and robust corrections of predictive distributions for tail events when training examples are limited.
